english.note: This is the all-purpose way to express movement toward the south.
This is the all-purpose way to indicate movement or direction toward the south.

examples.english: If we walk south, we’ll reach the beach.
examples.traditional: 我哋向南行就到海灘喇。

examples.english: We walked southward along the waterfront.
examples.traditional: 我哋沿住海旁一路向南行。
